items.title: TRT Lighting modernises Frenchgate Tunnel with LED retrofit
items.summary: A road tunnel in Doncaster has been retrofitted from high-pressure sodium and fluorescent lighting to LED, addressing rising maintenance costs of the original 1990s-era installation.

items.title: Why Lighting Needs a Universal Luminaire Cutsheet
items.summary: A practising lighting designer has developed an AI-driven tool intended to standardise luminaire cutsheets, aiming to streamline how specification data is formatted and compared across manufacturers.

items.title: The Past of the Future, Quebec, Canada
items.summary: A flexible LED tube product has been integrated into a public sculpture installation in Quebec, illuminating the artwork as part of its design.
